हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A billionaire tycoon disguises himself as a delivery boy to find Kavya, the girl who once gave him hope. Kavya, an aspiring singer trapped in a toxic household, struggles to hold on to her dreams while the world pushes her down. As emotions grow and lives intertwine, secrets, power, and love clash in ways that will test them both. A gripping tale of hidden identity, ambition, and passion that will keep you hooked till the very end.
